assertions.message: CubX menu opens through the player-facing archive mode
Live CubZ menu identifies decoded CubeRot/CubeOpen TVA playback
All seven recovered CubZ selection ranges are available
CubZ open uses the decoded 0-50 source range
Idle rotation uses the recovered 20/20/20 degrees-per-second constant
Recovered CubX camera fly reaches its clamped source target
Camera fly reports the recovered (-75,725,-350) clamp
Recovered MenuManager limits and wildcard tags are live
The level-0 System/Tools/Earth/Grid shell plus always-visible Arrow/Sun is live
Arrow uses decoded Fleche.tvm geometry
System preserves its recovered source coordinate
Tools preserves its recovered source coordinate
Earth preserves its recovered source coordinate
Arrow preserves its recovered source coordinate
Sun preserves its recovered source coordinate
Cube 1 follows the source's direct open path
CubX remains in the open phase at the diagnostic midpoint
Open progress samples continuously inside the decoded 0-50 range
CubZ reaches decoded frame 50 at the fully open pose
CubX close starts from the decoded open endpoint
CubX remains in the close phase at the diagnostic midpoint
Close samples the same CubZ source interval in reverse
CubX returns to its idle bind layout after reverse playback
BallZ cube starts its recovered snap/open chain
BallZ cube reaches its dedicated selector screen
Ball selector exposes Fire, Classic, and Revival in source-facing order
BallFire and BallShell recovered meshes are loaded
fire selector updates both CubX and live race state
classic2015 selector updates both CubX and live race state
revival selector updates both CubX and live race state
CubX menu can be reopened for satellite interaction QA
System satellite accepts its evidence-bounded inspect action
System stays in CubX because its recovered explosion destination is unavailable
Earth satellite accepts its recovered no-op inspect action
Earth remains inspect-only because the recovered click handler is empty
Tools satellite activates its recovered Car Scene destination
Tools opens the recovered Impreza Car Scene
Tools destination finishes loading the recovered terrain and car catalog
Recovered Impreza begins its archived gravity drop after Tools opens Car Scene
CubX menu can be reopened for Arrow semantics
CubZ opens before testing the ALLMENU Arrow
CubZ reaches open state before Arrow activation
Arrow remains actionable while CubZ is open
ALLMENU Arrow restores menu level 0 and begins closing CubZ
Arrow returns the CubZ shell to idle level 0
CubX menu can be reopened before the sun raycast check
Rendered SUN control is discoverable as the strong red WebGL target
CubX WebGL canvas has a clickable layout box
Clicking the rendered 3D sun launches the flightx-pipe race
CubX UI revival has no browser console or page errors

visualAdapter.pending: Box.tvm, Earth.tvm, Sphere.tvm and their original CubX textures are not yet present in the browser converter output
visualAdapter.presentation: Uniform constellation scale plus procedural box/earth shells; Earth-grid spin has no recovered source rate

reverseRepair.implementedBehavior: Reverse traverses the same animation ID/range used by forward playback, from its decoded end frame to its decoded start frame.
reverseRepair.reason: For selections 1-6 the reverse ID is a different range than the forward ID; selection 7 requests ID 8 although CubeRot contains only IDs 0-7. This is a source/binary inconsistency, not behavior to reproduce as intended design.

visualAdapter.exact: CubeRot GlobalCube and CubeOpen Right08/Top08/Left08 stored quaternion tracks, source ranges, 30 fps timing and same-range reverse playback
visualAdapter.pending: Original CubZ actor/button geometry/material conversion and a verified TV3D-to-Three handedness transform

idle.coordinateSystem: Three.js world coordinates: +x right/east, +y up, -z is the default forward direction.
idle.controls: Click one of the eight 3D cubes; choose one of four unfolded panels; Close reverses the open and rotation sequence.

visualAdapter.pending: Box.tvm, Earth.tvm, Sphere.tvm and their original CubX textures are not yet present in the browser converter output

decodedExact.timing: MANS source ranges and 30 fps are decoded exactly.
decodedExact.storedKeys: Stored MANI quaternion keys are returned in original float32 source order at exact source frames.
decodedExact.openTracks: CubeOpen materially changes only Right08, Top08 and Left08.

interpolation.method: normalized shortest-arc quaternion SLERP between the two surrounding decoded keys
interpolation.rationale: Quaternion interpolation is the narrowest transform-preserving interpolation supported by the decoded unit-quaternion evidence; no authored easing curve is invented.

coordinateSpace.rotationInterpretation: The four stored rotation floats are emitted in source order and labeled x,y,z,w because every decoded key is unit length within 1e-6 and identity keys are [0,0,0,~1].
coordinateSpace.boundary: No TV3D-to-Three.js handedness conversion, Euler conversion, interpolation mode, or procedural easing is asserted here.
